verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export capability, such as a full workspace export to CSV or JSON. What it does show are developer building blocks: a REST API that returns JSON. It also lists third-party extraction tools (Fivetran, Airbyte, Skyvia) in the app directory. Neither counts as the product itself offering complete export in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
